sections.title: Overview
descriptions: This page brings together available employment and compensation records related to Suzanne M. Nordin.
Suzanne M. Nordin is listed as an administrative assistant I in the latest available Transparent Utah records for fiscal year 2026.
She is married to AFPD officer Joseph A. Nordin, a relationship corroborated through Utah County marriage records.

sections.title: Employment
descriptions: Transparent Utah records list Suzanne M. Nordin's work for American Fork from fiscal year 2019 through 2026. The latest listed position is Administrative Assistant I.

The records list Records Specialist in 2019, Victim Advocate Secretary in 2020–2022, and Administrative Assistant I in 2023–2026. AFPD's FY2024 organizational chart describes her role as a part-time victim advocate. The table also includes a separate Utah Valley University position.
These years are based on reported pay, not exact hire or departure dates. Records through 2026 suggest continued employment, but do not confirm current status.
Suzanne and Joseph Nordin both appear in American Fork compensation records beginning in 2019. Those records do not establish whether their employment began before or after their marriage.

With spouses working in the same department, it is worth asking who handled the hiring and whether their work overlaps in ways that could affect supervision or decisions involving either spouse. The relationship alone does not establish favoritism or a conflict in a particular decision.
